name: Luigi Villoresi
features: olive skin, dark wavy hair, dark eyes, strong straight nose, handsome angular face, lean build, dashing confident expression
bio: 'Gigi' Villoresi was the finest voiturette driver of the late 1930s, dominant in the Maserati 4CL and 6CM, and the man who brought the young Alberto Ascari into racing. He carried his career across the war into Ferrari, Maserati and Lancia, and was still winning Grands Prix in the 1950s.
